set.body: From the S4.5a review (s45a-plot-host). BuiltPlot requires exactly one mark or Unplotted per ref (PlotKit.scala ~141-150), byRef is a Map and PlotMark has one row; UnplottedReason has only MissingValue. S4.5b histogram fallback (>50 controls, one bar for many rows), S4.5c missing-as-dashed-empty-marker (drawn, no position), linked pairs / grand-mean ticks and S4.5d group means cannot be expressed. Proposal: PlotMark.rows non-empty set; 'represented by aggregate mark' accounting; marks without a value position excluded from the position-parity property but still in the TableTwin; extra UnplottedReason cases. Keep PlotTableParitySuite properties true for the extended model. Must land before S4.5b/c/d.
set.title: S4.5x Plot API: marks for several rows, positionless marks, more Unplotted reasons
